t: In front of you is the Broadgate Venus, a bronze reclining figure from 1989 in Exchange Square, in the City of London. It's by the Colombian artist Fernando Botero, whose style of deliberately oversized, exaggerated volume is known as Boterismo. Writers have noted how her generous proportions sit comfortably among the big surrounding buildings. Other public works nearby include Fulcrum by Richard Serra and Rush Hour by George Segal. She has also turned up on lists of the city's raciest artworks.
